notes.title: Lifecraft is evolving again!
notes.content:
[h2][b]HELLO EVERYONE!
[/b][/h2]

Here we are to update you about upcoming updates for Lifecraft! We spent a lot of time implementing a flexible system to manage and let organism live inside and outside your organism. Things started little but during the way we understood it was necessary to have a proper goal-oriented AI system to manage what the cells will do and how they'll handle their priorities so the system itself became [b]HUGE[/b].

That's why at some point we changed our focus to start working on a very useful feature, both for us and both for you: a blueprint system together with library and a way to share the schematics beween players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42125058/f41add3fd449c87358377c27a7258eb745f885e4.png[/img]

[b]BLUEPRINT SYSTEM[/b]

The much requested blueprints system is coming! We plan to roll it out in the next 1-2 weeks on the nightly build.
The first version will be available only on sandbox to be tested, then we'll add it to survival games too (which requires more work as bluepirnt must be built by diffusers!).

You will be able to save map selections as blueprints, save them into a library and share them between players and your other worlds. Blueprints can be rotated and flipped to suit any need!

We also added a special label plate structure used just to show an icon which can be a nice aesthetics touch to your blueprint (or worlds).

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42125058/8a7d5b387e535850a8ca2870554b51a22e5b445e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42125058/0e067ce4408a8b4e1bd42896350ab88f42906092.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42125058/f2c63485bc6f9aff5d29adcf389581de27c863f1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42125058/f41add3fd449c87358377c27a7258eb745f885e4.png[/img]

[b]QUALITY OF LIFE UPDATES 
[/b]
We're also constantly working on QOL updates, especially on the constantly reviewed UI and microtubules determinism has been vastly improved, among with new picker mechanics.
Also tweaks to Evolution view!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42125058/f41add3fd449c87358377c27a7258eb745f885e4.png[/img]

[b]PATHWAYS UPDATE[/b]

We're integrating concepts like cellular expansion and stem tissue development in the Pathways, to help players understanding better what to do in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42125058/f41add3fd449c87358377c27a7258eb745f885e4.png[/img]

[b]ENDGAME UPDATES 
[/b]
We feel like that lacking a goal makes the game feel more unfinished than it is, so we decided to implement a temporary "end-game" which can give players purpose. 

This structure will reside in extracellular space for now but in the future the end-game itself will be tweaked as more subsystems (circulation, breathing) will be introduced so don't take this as final.

This, massive, hard to build "thing", gives the game an end-goal and a brand-new achievement!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42125058/c75337e81b6f3a8e160fbcaf5315f51def04dc1a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42125058/f41add3fd449c87358377c27a7258eb745f885e4.png[/img]

[b]HATCHING AND DEFENDING 
[/b]
As we said in the beginning, a lot of progress has been made towards hemocyte hatching, the primordial immune cell gameplay loop that will introduce exploration and defense from pathogens in the early game.
This infrastructure will be the same mechanics that will be used to produce red blood cells for circulation so it will be nice to have some feedback to help us balance everything.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42125058/00c587cf9342d48498c83004fc8eb428b8daf4bf.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42125058/f41add3fd449c87358377c27a7258eb745f885e4.png[/img]

[b]GOALS AND ACHIEVEMENTS
[/b]
All of this will result in new goals and achievements being added to the game, making the experience more complete overall.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42125058/f41add3fd449c87358377c27a7258eb745f885e4.png[/img]

[b]MUSIC TRACKS[/b]

In addition, a fresh music track is currently in the works, and we're exploring zone-specific tracks to enhance immersion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42125058/822050dd38e32150389f3fa54d3ff90a7b46adb7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42125058/f41add3fd449c87358377c27a7258eb745f885e4.png[/img]

We're eager to bring you these exciting new developments and will keep you updated as we approach release.

As always, thank you for your continuous feedback and support. Join us on Discord to discuss this update further!

Until next time, keep growing!

notes.title: Lifecraft 0.2.0 Digestion update has been released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42125058/11def563f2bf6aaaa590f25d661adfa12487f86f.gif[/img]

[b]Hi everyone! The Lifecraft 0.2.0 Digestion update has been released!
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42125058/5352008200e3447fc5360c86b9345de744c71f94.png[/img]

This update focuses on the much talked digestion and extracellular updates going finally public! We've also introduced a lot of user interface changes and quality-of-life improvements, making the game much easier and more streamlined to play. We’ve implemented many suggestions (including those from negative reviews—yes, we’re listening).

Here's a bunch:

[b]Pick and drop multiple items with shift
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42125058/7861f5fa3bd48684a04f987b39afbf92a7b2522a.gif[/img]

[b]Better microtubule placement
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42125058/66502258b3bb9b82b77bd5e440c54adce3e1c196.gif[/img]

[b]Drag and drop items
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42125058/6df060ef1fdb738af468003ce0f4883824bf603d.gif[/img]

[b]Automate Intracellular building
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42125058/864ff1363a31df231ea9555f0bcee132b44ac7cc.gif[/img]

It also marks the beginning of our first extracellular expansion: digestion! You can now expand your cell with extracellular digestive tissue on a much larger scale. Exchange digested materials with appropriate stoma, tanks, vessels and anus structures, and then use them to further expand your cell.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42125058/d02cd824ab973df42d8408376552e68308cc7189.png[/img]

We also wanted to add new organisms that are currently in development, but we felt the changes we had so far were starting to pile up. So, we decided to release this improved version of the game first.

In the coming weeks, we’ll add new achievements, goals, journey and incorporate all the feedback we receive on this patch.

We hope you enjoy the changes, and as usual, you can find us on Discord to share your experience directly with us and our community.

notes.title: Lifecraft Primordial Digestion Nightly
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We're moving toward the first big update of Lifecraft, that will add the first subsystem: digestion! This first part of digestion will include small intestine and it will be a simple way to consume food that will get more complicated over time with future updates.
We spent last 2 months working on a lot of core features of the game that will be used for all the extracellular systems that will come.

This update allows a first primordial digestion through specialized buildings which absorb and dispose of food and a special tank building which is able to digest nutrients and will be used in the future in other subsystems.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42125058/daedae7f4726952386e540d4ab926c569d164f56.png[/img]

We're quite satisfied with the result so far but we had to lay infrastructure for core mechanics like:

[list]
[*] extracellular buildings, which are not directly build but must be build through dispatchers
[*] vessels which can join to structures and can have flows which move elements inside
[*] how to place and retrieve items from vessels
[*] tanks mechanics
[/list]

In addition we spent some time to improve the overall QoL of the game by enhancing controls and UI according to the feedback you all provided.

The update is not ready yet [b][u]but you can freely test the experimental features on the nightly branch[/u][/b] of the game! Mind that these features are still unfinished and require a lot of tweaking.
Don't worry about your save games, the nightly user data is separated from your main game data!

notes.title: Lifecraft Modding
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
In these days we're working to the new update but meawhile we're investing some time in exploring how modding would integrate with the game. 

The game already supports a basic modding infrastructure but to properly make it work a lot of steps must be taken. Mind that the game is developer on a custom C++ engine so we don't have anything out of the box!

[list]
[*] define a native interface which "exposes" to modders all the feature of the game, this would allow efficient compiled mods as DLLs
[*] choose a scripting language to write mods, to provide a less efficient but easier to use interface
[*] define the bridge between native and scripted interface to bind all the calls
[*] define how to properly manage mods in save games (how to enable/disable them, how to keep track of versions and interactions and so on)
[*] finally implement the functionality on SteamWorks (or even better a custom in game interface) to let you share them in a common way.
[/list]

You can see that this is a [b]LOT[/b] of work, that's why, together with multiplayer, we are slowly doing it in spare time from working on game content.

The overall native API structure has been chosen and it's currently under development, this is a very long process because all the characteristics of the game must be correctly exposed to be altered by mods.

The scripting language chosen is [url=https://www.angelcode.com/angelscript/]AngelScript[/url], which is a really mature scripting language which is able to wrap underlying C++ code in a rather efficient way.

The mapping between native and scripted functions is already started and it automatically generates the documentation:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42125058/cc7e794e31aa7ae4371a159c96bdb4051d82daed.png[/img]

Basic mod loading mechanics is under development, that's not an easy task but something is already working and you can see the final example here:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42125058/3212f2033738293c2344de2a10fc8347d00f011d.png[/img]

This is just a simple example but it's to give you an idea!

[i]TL;DR: modding is long and complicate to implement, some elements are already working and hopefully we'll be able to enable testing your own mods in the nightly branch soon, without much support for sharing them or making them interact but it's a good start anyway.[/i]

Have fun!

notes.title: v0.1.0e - Lysosomes and polarization
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Welcome to our newest patch, v0.1.0e.

This version comes from the nightly branch to bring to everyone lysosomes and a new algorithm for item transportation on tubules!

Lysosomes can be used to recycle structures and they will have future purposes with next upcoming big update (someone said digestion?).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42125058/c199165c22890feaa2d2966862e4fbe2ad8936ab.png[/img]

The microtubules flow, as explained in a previous devlog, has been changed to behave more naturally, with less intervention and frustration from your part. We feel like this new mechanics can override the existing one and it should work out of the box on your existing worlds, with just minor issues.

We also added a pathways view (can be opened with P) which show how elements of the game interact between themselves, to give you a overall idea of what you are supposed to do. It's still experimental and we plan to expand it with all the included mechanics to be a navigable map for all of you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42125058/beb3bb47ec39655950469c041ba24efc3c0e159a.png[/img]

In addition some issues has been fixed and improved, have fun and stay tuned for future updates!
Remember: [b]Body must grow![/b]

Here is the full changelog:
[list]
[*] Fixed issues with items on microtubules which were getting stuck 
[*] Added polarization of microtubules which will allow movement according to layout
[*] Added pathways view (button in top left bar, bound to key P, still WIP)
[*] Added lysosome zone used to recycle materials (and for future purposes)
[*] Added catabolyzer building which dismantle items
[*] Added membrane transporters used for lysosome
[*] Fixed help notifications which were reappearing on game load
[*] Fixed sandbox popup menu positioning with UI scale > 1.0
[*] Fixed cotransporter arrows which were disappearing when transporter had items
[*] Added experimental building shadows graphics enhancement
[*] Stockpiles and infinite container in sandbox can now be filled with categories of items
[*] Added object overlay info to workbench
[*] Added object overlay info to energy supplier
[*] Added transporter mode symbols to recipe tooltip
[*] Added layer allowance of structures in their tooltip
[*] Added some animated tips
[*] Added unconfigured symbol to membrane transporter without transporter set
[*] Added option to hide work in progress evolution tree nodes (enabled by default)
[*] Trivia and tips are now localizable
[*] Improved French translation (thanks Ookamiko)
[*] Improved Chinese translation (thanks Ulire)
[/list]

notes.title: Nightly Branch
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We're working on a lot of additions to the game but in the meanwhile we thought it would have been nice to let you peek and play the content!

That's why we enabled a [b]nightly branch[/b] which can be accessed without any password directly from your Steam clients.

We will use this branch to deploy unfinished features and let you test them, currently we added:

[list]
[*] lysosomes to recycle structures and materials
[*] a new microtubule flow algorithm which automatically decides the flow for your items
[*] a pathways view which explain the main interaction between things in the game, that will be expanded to cover all the game mechanics
[/list]
[i]You can verify the current nightly changelog directly within the game from the changelog button in main menu[/i]

Meanwhile we're working toward first breedable organism (a scout cell!) and  more refined heap management for expansion and possibly internalization of them.

Nightly options and save data won't be shared between the official game and the experimental one (it will be contained in a nightly folder inside the game user data main folder) so this won't affect your game at all, feel free to experiment!

notes.title: v0.1.0d
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

This patch addresses some usability issues reported by the players.We uniformed all the overall game window scale so that you can customize them altogether with the global interface scale setting, which now affects also main menu.

Some interactions(namely : stash and assemble) has been moved to opposite mouse button compared to now to avoid confusion, a setting to swap left / right mouse buttons with respect to world / item interactions has been added.

Tutorial has been improved and what you can do with the mouse is now shown near the cursor.

We started working on a feature which will guide you in a visual way throughout the progression of what you can do, we'll update you with more info shortly!

Meanwhile have fun with this update!

notes.title: Early Access Release Date and Beta v0.0.4!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
We've finally set the release date, it's 16th April!

All the features we wanted to have in the early access launch are implemented, we will be using these last two months to fix the remaining bugs, prepare some localizations and make some tweaks around.

[i]Meanwhile  enjoy the fixes and thank you for your feedback in tracking down various bugs.
[/i]

[list]
[*] Added achievements (it’s intended that they have no icons)
[*] Viewport position is now saved between sessions
[*] It’s now possible to drag mouse cursor while placing objects in free mode
[*] Moving the viewport while placing microtubules now places them
[*] Item kicker is now properly given back when removed from tile
[*] Added option to hide unknown recipes from recipe list (default: true)
[*] Added settings to hide ground props on tile with railings
[*] Pickers now correctly hide ground props
[*] Tweaked bacterial colonies expansion speed
[*] Fixed some ground cytosol graphical glitches
[*] Fixed item tunnel cap graphical glitch
[*] Some UI QoL around
[/list]

notes.title: v0.0.3a - beta #5
notes.content:
[i]This beta is introducing another game mode which is adventure, in which you can control a character (which will be customizable in the future). It's not finished so for now it's just a WIP. Enjoy![/i]

[list]
[*] Added experimental adventure mode with a character that can be controlled
[*] Added a placeholder door structure necessary to let players move between zones in adventure mode
[*] Added connexon to build gap junctions between different intracellular zones
[*] Dispatchers can’t be placed on cell membrane anymore (to simplify)
[*] Pickers can’t be placed on extracellular tissues anymore
[*] Multiple item drag is now implicit on structures which only act as source
[*] Advanced new game options have been moved in their own view
[*] Added tooltip to warn when a recipe can’t be produced inside a zone
[*] Added world generation setting for darkness intensity
[*] Added option to disable auto pause on load game
[*] Added fix to sensibility of pickup while dragging with right mouse button
[*] Force pickup modifier now doesn’t alternate dropping item when hand is full
[*] Added validation of starting area to avoid locked out situations
[/list]

A lot of engine code has been changed for future features so it's possible there could be some issues, don't forget to report them in Discord!
